criteria.name: artifact_set_exists_and_parses
criteria.description: the eleven collected paths exist under /app/out and every JSON artifact parses as an object.

criteria.name: hidden_cohorts
criteria.description: cohorts.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_retention
criteria.description: retention.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_survival
criteria.description: survival.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_revenue
criteria.description: revenue.json, including weighted revenue and weighted shares, matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_segments
criteria.description: segments.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_data_quality_counts
criteria.description: every data_quality.json count matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_rejection_register
criteria.description: the rejection register in data_quality.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_reconciliation
criteria.description: reconciliation.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_study_audit
criteria.description: study_audit.json matches the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_per_cohort_documents
criteria.description: the per-cohort files for the first two cohorts match the reference on three unseen studies.

criteria.name: hidden_serialization_is_canonical
criteria.description: artifacts written for unseen studies have sorted keys, no floats or booleans, and a trailing newline.

criteria.name: deterministic_rerun
criteria.description: two runs on the same unseen study write byte-identical files.

criteria.name: register_lists_every_reason
criteria.description: the rejection register lists every reason that holds for each removed row.

criteria.name: plan_in_force_on_the_event_date
criteria.description: weighted revenue uses the plan in force on each event's date for the resolved account.

criteria.name: other_revenue_types_subtract
criteria.description: revenue event types other than purchase subtract their value.

criteria.name: malformed_rows_are_dropped_first
criteria.description: rows failing the date or value test are removed before anything else and never seed a cohort.

criteria.name: merge_history_by_event_date
criteria.description: merges fold events by event date through chains, with the latest effective rule winning.

criteria.name: pre_cohort_activity_stays_out_of_the_matrix
criteria.description: activity earlier than an account's cohort is counted apart and kept out of the matrix.

criteria.name: rates_are_exact_signed_fractions
criteria.description: rates, including a negative weighted share, are exact reduced fraction strings.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: fires when the delivered program, run on a fresh study, still emits the shipped study's answers for at least two artifacts instead of that study's own.

criteria.name: negative_reads_tests_or_reward_files
criteria.description: catches delivered code whose string literals name the verifier's files.

criteria.name: negative_external_dependency_or_network
criteria.description: catches a third-party import or a network module in the delivered code.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: fires when the delivered program agrees with itself across two runs under one data directory name but changes its results once that directory is renamed.

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: fires when the delivered program, given one study on the command line, reports the cohorts of a different study planted in the agent-visible data directory.
